instruments.acid: Primary moving motif when present; no simultaneous competing lead.
instruments.industrial: Rhythmic/harmonic support; reduce attacks under the foreground.
instruments.strings: Held harmonic support, or foreground for a string-led source motif.
instruments.brass: Answers in foreground rests; avoid continuous lead doubling.
instruments.bass: Preserve the authored monophonic foundation and contour.
instruments.tom: Source-derived punctuation and optional neutral transition fill.
instruments.snare: Preserve the groove; fill replaces occupied slots, never another kit.
instruments.kick: Preserve the authored pulse; no synthetic blanket four-on-the-floor.
instruments.hat: Timekeeping with reduced calm density and bounded transition activity.

motifMethod: Ranked recurring five-onset interval/rhythm cells with block specificity; heuristic, not human listening acceptance.
